versions.prompt: This is my apartment lease in {place}. Which clauses in it conflict with {place} landlord-tenant law? For each one, quote the clause exactly as it is written in the lease and cite the specific statute or regulation section it conflicts with.

clause.description: The clause, quoted exactly from the lease

citation.description: Statute or regulation section it conflicts with

gt.clause_excerpt: Eviction. If you fail to pay rent, or any other charge hereunder otherwise defined as rent, we or our agents/attorney(s) may forthwith file a non-payment suit for possession of the Apartment.
gt.issue: Allows immediate nonpayment suit without the required 10-day pre-filing notice

flag.title: DC law requires a 30-day written notice to cure or vacate for nonpayment and bars eviction for nonpayment of amounts other than rent, so 'forthwith' filing for 'any other charge' is unlawful.
flag.clause: Eviction. If you fail to pay rent, or any other charge hereunder otherwise defined as rent, we or our agents/attorney(s) may forthwith file a non-payment suit for possession of the Apartment.
flag.why: DC law requires a 30-day written notice to cure or vacate for nonpayment and bars eviction for nonpayment of amounts other than rent, so 'forthwith' filing for 'any other charge' is unlawful.

gt.clause_excerpt: As owner of the animal, you’re strictly liable for the entire amount of any injury that the animal causes to a person or anyone’s property. You’ll indemnify us for all costs of litigation and attorney’s fees resulting from any such damage.
gt.issue: Requires tenant to pay owner's litigation costs and attorney's fees

flag.title: Shifting the owner's attorney's fees and litigation costs to the tenant by lease term is prohibited.
flag.clause: You'll indemnify us for all costs of litigation and attorney's fees resulting from any such damage.
flag.why: Shifting the owner's attorney's fees and litigation costs to the tenant by lease term is prohibited.

gt.clause_excerpt: Resident(s) agrees that Resident(s) shall never make demand upon, look to, institute or prosecute suit against Manager, or any of Manager’s agents, contractors, employees or representatives, their heirs, successors or assigns, for any damages, costs, loss of personal property, damage or injury to Resident(s) person as a result of, arising out of or incidental to the installation, operation, repair or replacement, or use of the controlled access.
gt.issue: Covenant not to sue owner over controlled access operation or repair

flag.title: An express covenant not to sue and release of all liability relating to a building system is a prohibited exculpatory clause insulating the owner from its own negligence.
flag.clause: Resident(s) agrees that Resident(s) shall never make demand upon, look to, institute or prosecute suit against Manager, or any of Manager's agents, contractors, employees or representatives, their heirs, successors or assigns, for any damages, costs, loss of personal property, damage or injury to Resident(s) person as a result of, arising out of or incidental to the installation, operation, repair or replacement, or use of the controlled access.
flag.why: An express covenant not to sue and release of all liability relating to a building system is a prohibited exculpatory clause insulating the owner from its own negligence.

gt.clause_excerpt: In the event Manager is found liable for any loss or injury as a result of Manager’s installation or use of the controlled access, notwithstanding Resident(s) express waiver of Manager’s responsibility with respect to the controlled access, Resident(s) agree to waive and relinquish all rights to proceed against Manager except to the extent of Manager’s interest in the Property of which Resident(s) unit is a part.

flag.why: Capping recovery at the owner's property interest limits the owner's liability for negligence, which the regulation forbids.

gt.clause_excerpt: Owner and management are not responsible for loss, damage or injury.

gt.clause_excerpt: Resident(s) agrees the Manager is not liable to Resident(s), Resident(s) family, Resident(s) guests or other occupants for any injury, damage, or loss whatsoever which is caused as a result of any problem, defect, malfunction or failure of the performance of the controlled access.
gt.issue: Exempts owner from all injury caused by controlled access malfunctions

flag.title: A blanket advance waiver of notice and demand is a prohibited waiver clause; any lease provision waiving the protections of 14 DCMR ch. 3 is void and unenforceable.
flag.clause: Except when notice or demand is required by statute, you waive any notice and demand for performance from us if you default.
flag.why: A blanket advance waiver of notice and demand is a prohibited waiver clause; any lease provision waiving the protections of 14 DCMR ch. 3 is void and unenforceable.

flag.title: This is a broad assumption-of-risk/exculpatory clause that purports to relieve the owner of liability, which the regulation prohibits to the extent it limits liability for the owner's own negligence.
flag.clause: You acknowledge and agree that living in an urban environment, such as Washington, D.C., has risks and dangers that are beyond our control. We cannot be, and are not responsible, legally nor otherwise to protect you from these risks and dangers, unless otherwise compelled to do so under law, and you agree to assume all such risks and dangers as part of your tenancy.
flag.why: This is a broad assumption-of-risk/exculpatory clause that purports to relieve the owner of liability, which the regulation prohibits to the extent it limits liability for the owner's own negligence.

flag.title: It allows termination of tenancy at the owner's option outside the exclusive statutory grounds for eviction and compels a blanket waiver of the tenant's independent legal claims.
flag.clause: In the event the Apartment, or any part thereof, is taken by condemnation by any government agency or authority, your tenancy will be terminated at our option. You hereby specifically assign to us any portion of the award payable as damages for the taking of the property, and you waive any right to participate or make any claim in such condemnation proceedings.
flag.why: It allows termination of tenancy at the owner's option outside the exclusive statutory grounds for eviction and compels a blanket waiver of the tenant's independent legal claims.

flag.title: To the extent it disclaims duties the Housing Regulations impose (e.g., adequate lighting and secure premises) and limits liability for the owner's negligence in maintaining them, the disclaimer is void.
flag.clause: We are not obliged to furnish security personnel, security lighting, security gates or fences, or other forms of security unless required by statute or regulation. We do not provide any security measures or devices.
flag.source: 14 DCMR §§ 301.1 and 304.3; D.C. Official Code § 42-3505.01 et seq.
flag.why: To the extent it disclaims duties the Housing Regulations impose (e.g., adequate lighting and secure premises) and limits liability for the owner's negligence in maintaining them, the disclaimer is void.

flag.title: A categorical no-rent-abatement provision conflicts with the implied warranty of habitability and the tenant's non-waivable remedies, including rent withholding/abatement for Housing Code violations.
flag.clause: Unless otherwise required by law, rent will not abate in whole or in part.
flag.why: A categorical no-rent-abatement provision conflicts with the implied warranty of habitability and the tenant's non-waivable remedies, including rent withholding/abatement for Housing Code violations.

flag.title: Unilateral self-help exclusion based solely on the landlord's judgment, without judicial process, exceeds the landlord's lawful remedies.
flag.clause: We may exclude from the apartment community guests, visitors or others who, in our judgment, have been violating the law, violating this Lease Contract or any apartment rules and community policies, or disturbing other tenants, neighbors, visitors, or owner representatives.
flag.why: Unilateral self-help exclusion based solely on the landlord's judgment, without judicial process, exceeds the landlord's lawful remedies.

flag.title: Acceleration of all future rent as immediately due, coupled with only a conditional mitigation obligation, conflicts with the landlord's duty to mitigate and with limits on recoverable damages in DC.
flag.clause: all monthly rent and other charges for the remainder of the Lease Contract term or renewal period will be payable by you to us as damages incurred by us, and will be immediately due and delinquent
flag.why: Acceleration of all future rent as immediately due, coupled with only a conditional mitigation obligation, conflicts with the landlord's duty to mitigate and with limits on recoverable damages in DC.

flag.title: A fixed double-rent penalty for holdover is a punitive liquidated charge inconsistent with DC's requirement that a holdover tenant's tenancy continue on existing terms until lawfully terminated through the courts.
flag.clause: if you hold over after the date contained in your move-out notice, you shall be liable to us for rent at double the rate payable according to the terms of the tenancy for all the time that you shall wrongfully hold over
flag.why: A fixed double-rent penalty for holdover is a punitive liquidated charge inconsistent with DC's requirement that a holdover tenant's tenancy continue on existing terms until lawfully terminated through the courts.

flag.title: It converts breach of a separately characterized commercial parking license into grounds to terminate the residential tenancy, outside the statutory grounds for eviction.
flag.clause: Any violation of the License for Enclosed Garage, Carport, or Storage Unit is a material breach of lease
flag.why: It converts breach of a separately characterized commercial parking license into grounds to terminate the residential tenancy, outside the statutory grounds for eviction.

flag.title: The provision tends to place the burden of preserving the jury-trial right on the tenant and warns of waiver, in tension with the flat prohibition on lease provisions affecting a residential tenant's jury trial right.
flag.clause: In the District of Columbia, you have the right to a jury trial in any legal proceeding. It is your obligation to ascertain the circumstances for seeking and securing a jury trial, and your right thereto may be waived should you not proceed in accordance with District of Columbia law.
flag.why: The provision tends to place the burden of preserving the jury-trial right on the tenant and warns of waiver, in tension with the flat prohibition on lease provisions affecting a residential tenant's jury trial right.

flag.title: The garbled clause misstates security deposit law; DC regulations govern application and return of deposits and do not impose this blanket prohibition as written.
flag.clause: You're prohibited by law from applying any security deposit to rent you won't stay beyond the date you state in your move-out notice.
flag.why: The garbled clause misstates security deposit law; DC regulations govern application and return of deposits and do not impose this blanket prohibition as written.

flag.title: The 45-day clock runs from termination of the tenancy, not from a condition imposed on the tenant, and the landlord's duty to account or refund cannot be made contingent in this way.
flag.clause: All Tenants, guests, and occupants must abandon the apartment before the forty-five (45) day period for us to provide you with a written list of any damages to the Premises together with a statement of costs properly incurred or Rent unpaid that will form the basis of a deduction from your Security Deposit or tender payment to you of the Security Deposit.
flag.why: The 45-day clock runs from termination of the tenancy, not from a condition imposed on the tenant, and the landlord's duty to account or refund cannot be made contingent in this way.

flag.title: Each tenant is entitled to statutory notice and accounting regarding the deposit; limiting notice to a single tenant conflicts with the required delivery of notice to the tenant personally or by certified mail.
flag.clause: Security deposit refunds will only be issued via one check, and any deduction itemizations will be mailed to one Tenant only.
flag.why: Each tenant is entitled to statutory notice and accounting regarding the deposit; limiting notice to a single tenant conflicts with the required delivery of notice to the tenant personally or by certified mail.

flag.title: Continuing rent liability triggered solely by the tenant's refusal to sign a surrender form imposes a penalty untethered to possession and conflicts with the statutory framework governing termination of tenancy.
flag.clause: Should you fail to sign such a form, you will be held liable for all rents and other charges which accrue; 1) Until the date such form is signed, or 2) Until the last day of the month in which the US Marshal's Service has executed a Writ of Restitution for the apartment.
flag.why: Continuing rent liability triggered solely by the tenant's refusal to sign a surrender form imposes a penalty untethered to possession and conflicts with the statutory framework governing termination of tenancy.

flag.title: It shifts the burden of proving payment onto the tenant despite the owner's affirmative duty to issue written receipts stating amount, date, purpose, and balance due.
flag.clause: It shall be irrefutably presumed, for purposes of this Apartment Lease Contract, that Resident has not paid rent or any of the charges unless Resident can produce a canceled check, money order, or documentation of electronic payment proving that rent has been paid.
flag.why: It shifts the burden of proving payment onto the tenant despite the owner's affirmative duty to issue written receipts stating amount, date, purpose, and balance due.

flag.title: A pre-emptive waiver of any reduction-in-services claim or rent relief conflicts with the implied warranty and the non-exclusive, non-waivable remedies preserved by the Housing Regulations.
flag.clause: The Parties expressly accept and agree that Landlord's limitation of access to or closing of common areas and amenity spaces shall not relieve Resident of any financial obligations arising under the Lease, and shall not serve as grounds for either party's termination of the Lease.
flag.why: A pre-emptive waiver of any reduction-in-services claim or rent relief conflicts with the implied warranty and the non-exclusive, non-waivable remedies preserved by the Housing Regulations.

flag.title: Immediate removal at the landlord's sole discretion, with no cure period and no carve-out for assistance/service animals, conflicts with cure rights and reasonable-accommodation obligations.
flag.clause: You must immediately and permanently remove the animal from the premises if we receive a reasonable complaint from a neighbor or other tenant or if we, in our sole discretion, determine that the animal has disturbed neighbors or other tenants.
flag.source: D.C. Official Code § 42-3505.01; 14 DCMR § 304.1; D.C. Official Code § 2-1401.01 et seq.
flag.why: Immediate removal at the landlord's sole discretion, with no cure period and no carve-out for assistance/service animals, conflicts with cure rights and reasonable-accommodation obligations.

flag.title: Shifting the cost and consequences of pest eradication onto the tenant conflicts with the owner's non-delegable Housing Code duty to keep the premises free of pests.
flag.clause: If you knowingly interfere with, obstruct, or actively hinder inspection for, or treatment to eradicate the presence of bedbugs in your dwelling unit, you will be in breach of your Lease, and we are entitled to terminate your Lease pursuant to applicable law based on your violation of an obligation of tenancy.
flag.why: Shifting the cost and consequences of pest eradication onto the tenant conflicts with the owner's non-delegable Housing Code duty to keep the premises free of pests.

flag.title: It imposes on the tenant the expense of extermination that the Housing Regulations assign to the owner as part of maintaining the premises free of infestation.
flag.clause: Unless otherwise prohibited by law, you are responsible for and must, at your own expense, have your own personal property, furniture, clothing and possessions treated according to accepted treatment methods established by a licensed pest control firm that we approve.
flag.source: 14 DCMR § 301.1 (implied warranty); DC Housing Code pest-control duties
flag.why: It imposes on the tenant the expense of extermination that the Housing Regulations assign to the owner as part of maintaining the premises free of infestation.

flag.title: Charging the tenant for lock changes conflicts with the owner's duty to furnish and maintain required locks and security devices in working order.
flag.clause: You must pay for any such change or rekeying, unless otherwise provided by law.
flag.source: 14 DCMR § 301.1; DC Housing Code lock and security-device requirements
flag.why: Charging the tenant for lock changes conflicts with the owner's duty to furnish and maintain required locks and security devices in working order.

flag.title: A fixed penalty charge that exceeds actual replacement cost functions as an unlawful penalty and, if collected up front as security for performance, implicates the security deposit cap and escrow rules.
flag.clause: Resident(s) shall be liable for a charge of $75.00 per device.
flag.why: A fixed penalty charge that exceeds actual replacement cost functions as an unlawful penalty and, if collected up front as security for performance, implicates the security deposit cap and escrow rules.

flag.title: As applied to addenda containing waivers and liability disclaimers, this supremacy clause cannot give effect to terms that are void and unenforceable under the Housing Regulations.
flag.clause: Where the terms or conditions found in this Addendum vary or contradict any terms or conditions found in the Lease Contract, this Addendum shall control.
flag.why: As applied to addenda containing waivers and liability disclaimers, this supremacy clause cannot give effect to terms that are void and unenforceable under the Housing Regulations.

flag.title: Read with the broader damages provisions allowing deductions for 'other damages and expenses suffered by Landlord as a result of a breach,' the deposit is used to secure obligations beyond those permitted, exceeding the lawful scope of a security deposit.
flag.clause: Any promise by the Tenant to leave, restore, surrender, or yield the Apartment in good repair does not obligate the Tenant to make substantial repairs, replace obsolete materials, or fix other defects without negligence or fault on the Tenant's part.
flag.why: Read with the broader damages provisions allowing deductions for 'other damages and expenses suffered by Landlord as a result of a breach,' the deposit is used to secure obligations beyond those permitted, exceeding the lawful scope of a security deposit.

flag.title: An unqualified indemnity/hold-harmless covering 'all liability' shifts to the tenant liability for the owner's own negligence in performing services, which is prohibited.
flag.clause: If you ask our representatives to perform services not contemplated in this Lease Contract, you will indemnify us and hold us harmless from all liability for these services.
flag.why: An unqualified indemnity/hold-harmless covering 'all liability' shifts to the tenant liability for the owner's own negligence in performing services, which is prohibited.

flag.clause: Furthermore, if such an event damages the Apartment or apartment community to materially affect its habitability by some or all tenants, we reserve the right to vacate any and all tenants and suspend or terminate tenancy, and you agree to excuse us from any further performance of obligations and undertakings hereunder, to the full extent allowed under applicable law.

flag.title: It demands immediate surrender of possession without a notice to vacate, court order, or U.S. Marshal-supervised eviction, bypassing the exclusive judicial eviction process.
flag.clause: In the event that the named Tenant(s) dies, all occupants must immediately vacate the Apartment.

In the event that the named Tenant(s) dies, all occupants must immediately vacate the Apartment.

flag.title: It purports to eliminate the written notice-to-cure/vacate required before the landlord may seek possession for a lease violation.
flag.clause: Such conduct is considered a default for which we need not give you notice.

Such conduct is considered a default for which we need not give you notice.

Resident agrees this one-time fee is not a security deposit but rather it is an additional payment negotiated as part of the Lease transaction. Additional Fee is not refundable or subject to abatement under any circumstances
